title: I Left the Cubicle-Lamp Photo on the Desk They Rolled to the Window

parts.text: I sat at 8:52 a.m. and my named lamp was on a desk that had rolled to the window row. Facilities had a map: DESKS STAY ON THE GRID. NO WINDOW MIGRATIONS. I was twenty-six, analyst, holding a nameplate photo. I left the lamp photo on the rolled desk they now occupied. Facilities rolled it back and laminated the grid. The window row finally looks like a map, not a prize. A paper policy is only paper until someone treats it like a clock.

social.video_title: They rolled my named desk to the window — Part 1/1
social.description: Cubicle lamp, a grid map, a window migration. The photo stayed. Has an office ever stolen daylight?
